item.title: Bus stop and under the bridge next to it extremely dirty with pigeons feathers and its odour, 20th August
item.description:
Pigeons live underneath the bridge next to Beckenham tram bus stop. That area is constantly dirty, but in the last 6 months it has increased. There's a strong odour of pigeons, there are pigeons feces and feathers on the ground, on both sides of the pavement. The bus stop is constantly extremely dirty adding to pigeon's feathers. Pigeons are extremely dirty, its feathers and feces can carry parasites adding to its odour which can also cause diseases even death to humans. I took a bus this morning from this bus stop. I spent not even 30 seconds as the bus arrived at the same time as I was approaching the bus stop. The odour was extremely strong, I couldn't breathe in a matter of a few seconds as just explained. Underneath the bridge and this Beckenham tram bus stop are hazard for humans. Could you, please, look into this request?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Beckenham Road, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
